answer: The orchard holds work receipts rather than names, so the karst of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on invitation quota tree, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing. By the ivory of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
